content:
One of my favorite Apple TV 4K features — the screensavers — will reportedly soon gain audio in tvOS 27. Here's what we know.

tvOS 27 code shows at least one Apple TV screensaver gaining audio options, and more are likely

October is expected to be a big month for Apple, with several new hardware and software launches on the horizon.

In addition to the rumored new Apple TV 4K, a leaked image from Apple's own code surfaced earlier today.

On the software side, leaker pdfu just posted evidence from the tvOS 27 codebase showing that at least one Apple TV screensaver is getting audio support.

As seen in the video above, the Snoopy screensaver has a hidden option to turn audio on or off, or use a "reduce" setting.

The example of the Snoopy screensaver doesn't seem too distracting, but I'm glad Apple is planning to let users disable the audio entirely.

Although pdfu hasn't discovered any other screensavers with audio support yet, there's a good chance Apple will expand this feature to more screensavers down the road.

What do you think about the possibility of tvOS 27 bringing audio options to Apple TV screensavers? Sound off in the comments.
